_readme: Public notices on the homepage. Each shows between 'from' and 'to' (MM-DD for every year, or YYYY-MM-DD for once; a range may wrap the new year). Up to four show at a time, in this order. Passes: the status of each comes from the season section of data/today.json by its id (the same report as Gidromet and the Gendarmerie); 'season_closed' is used only if that report is missing.

passes.name: Otmek Pass
passes.road: Old pass road, summer bypass of the Otmek Tunnel

notices.text: The heating season begins on 15 October in Talas and Nurzhan. Report radiator faults to your building administration.

notices.source: Road Patrol, Ministry of Internal Security
notices.text: Winter tyres are compulsory on all mountain roads from 1 November to 31 March. Carry chains on the passes.
Herds are returning from the summer pastures. Expect livestock on the Trans-Talas Highway near Kyzyl-Adyr, especially in the early morning.
Spring migration to the summer pastures has begun. Drivers should slow down for herds on district roads.

notices.source: Naryn Water and Power Protocol Commission
notices.text: Summer irrigation releases are in force on the Naryn. Downstream water users should follow the published schedule.
Central Talas will be closed to traffic on 11 March from 06:00 to 14:00 for the Irad Day parade.
Pilgrimage season: extra buses run from Talas and Tash-Kömür to Iyık Janyl until the Feast of the Cross on 14 September.
New Year's Eve: the square below the Altyn Tower will be closed to traffic from 18:00 on 31 December.
Applications for the national komuz competition close on 15 October. Forms are at district culture offices.
Polling day is Tuesday 2 November 2027. Check your registration at your district election office.
Foreign journalists must hold current accreditation from the Department of Public Information, Liberty Boulevard, Talas.
Denha, the Epiphany: the Archbishop blesses the waters at Nahrai's Ford, Iyık Janyl, after the morning Qurbana. Families may fill bottles at the spring trough by the chapel.
Memorial of Rabban Qayoma of Kara-Suu, the hermit. The Order of St. Janyl the Hermit keeps the day.
Memorial of Mar Shlemun of Taraz, the holy bishop. The Cathedral Seminary Library shows the Gospels of Iyık Janyl after the Qurbana.
Memorial of Mar Abdisho the Shepherd, as the herds go up. The Bishop of the Chatkal Highlands begins his summer ride at Abdisho-Mazar.
St. Nahrai the Ferryman, 10 June: dawn Qurbana at Nahrai's Ford and the blessing of the Naryn. The clergy come down the western pilgrim path in procession.
Memorial of Mart Terim the Physician: the dispensaries of the Sisters of the Cross and St. Luka are blessed.
Feast of St. Janyl, 24 August. Pilgrims: see the City Hall of Iyık Janyl for parking, water and first aid.
Memorial of Mart Kutlug and the Martyrs of Almaliq.
Memorial of Fr. Yawsep of the Passes, patron of refugees and of Iradis abroad. Prayers for the diaspora in every parish.
Commemoration of the New Martyrs and Confessors of 1937–38. The names are read in the cathedral and the great bell tolls.
Mar Yuhanna of Merv, the evangelist of the valley. Feast with its own Office.
